item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Yuxin (Dana) Shou, an undergraduate student at Peking University studying Artificial Intelligence. I’m particularly interested in the alignment between AI technology and human values — specifically, how we can leverage AI for social good. To me, AI is more than a technological shift; it is fundamentally reshaping how we think, create, communicate, and understand the world.

Besides pursuing my studies and career, in my free time I enjoy reading books on psychology and economics. I find it fascinating to explore why we feel and think the way we do, and why society functions the way it does. I also love traveling, playing the piano, and participating in all kinds of sports. Recently, I started playing squash :)
